column1: # Names the estate promises are *redirects*, and where each one must go.
# `check-edge-vhost-pins.py --redirect-pins` holds three copies to this file: the
# redirection row, the generated redirection file, and — the reason the file exists — the
# proxy-host list, because a name that quietly gains a proxy host is a retired name being
# served again rather than moved. The rows and files were read on 2026-11-09; every pair
# agreed, so this is that baseline rather than a wish list.
# Only names that are live redirections belong here. Retired infrastructure names are not
# redirects — they are parked on port 9 or absent — and pinning one as a redirect would
# forbid the estate from ever parking it.
